lines.en: Twenty acres, two roods and thirty-five perches of wood. The occupier: John Gedrick, as far as I can read Mr Stewart's hand. And look at this corner, sir: ten acres, three roods and thirty-nine perches of 'late Thos. Williams' land, added to Tŷ Mawr.
